name: light-keeper
description: Light Keeper — кооперативная браузерная игра на двоих

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @light-keeper/api" "npm run dev -w @light-keeper/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @light-keeper/api && npm run build -w @light-keeper/client
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run smoke
scripts.smoke: npm run build -w @light-keeper/api && npm run smoke -w @light-keeper/api
